protocol.inputs: Identical seeded tensors, weights, and bias in every process; same RAW source and model weights
protocol.precision: FP32; TF32 disabled; cuDNN autotuning on; deterministic=False

sensitivity.scope: Ten sequential full invocations divided by ten; separate from single-call latency

protocol.order: Case order and per-repetition method order independently randomized by process seed
protocol.null_control: cudnn_repeat is the same callable as cudnn under a second randomized label
protocol.timing_scope: CUDA event interval around full invocation, allocations included; synchronization before each interval
protocol.primary_unit: fresh-process median; individual calls are nested observations, not independent runs
protocol.inference: 95% bootstrap intervals across paired process medians; same GPU, no cross-device claim
protocol.practical_margin: Network speedup between 0.99 and 1.01 is a predeclared ±1% practical band, separate from significance

analysis.point_estimate: median of paired per-process median-time ratios
analysis.ci: 20,000 bootstrap resamples of paired process-level speedups; 95% percentile interval
analysis.p_test: exact paired sign-flip test of mean log speedup; Holm correction within family
analysis.families: 14 network custom-versus-cuDNN comparisons; 4 selected operator comparisons separately
analysis.limits: Same GPU and consecutive fresh-process runs; intervals do not cover other devices or arbitrary operating conditions
